title: Daily Small Talk
description: Practice simple everyday conversation and natural follow-up questions.
descriptionZh: 练习简单日常对话和自然追问。

context.setting: A friendly chat with a new acquaintance before a community activity.
context.learnerPurpose: Start small talk, answer simple questions, and keep the conversation going.

goals.label: Ask a follow-up question
successCriteria: Responds to the other person's answer

constraints: Keep the conversation warm and simple.
Ask one question at a time.
